h2: Building inclusive schools starts with empowered educators
p: Every school wants to create an environment where every child feels included, understood and able to thrive. However, making inclusive education work consistently can be challenging - and schools shouldn’t have to navigate this journey alone.

CognitiveBotics helps schools bring educators, specialists and families together through one connected platform, making it easier to personalise learning, track progress and support every child with confidence.
This helps schools spend less time trying to connect the dots, and more time helping children reach their potential.

h2: How schools support inclusive education, more consistently
p: A CONNECTED ECOSYSTEM
CognitiveBotics helps schools create a connected ecosystem where every interaction supports a child’s development, beyond the classroom
Practical support for teachers
Equip educators with neurodivergent-aware teaching strategies, guided classroom activities and practical resources that can be applied in everyday learning environments.
Individualised Education Plans (IEPs)
Create AI-assisted Individualised Education Plans that evolve with every child’s developmental progress, helping educators adapt goals as children grow.
Understand behaviour with confidence
Track in-session behavioural and emotional patterns to support timely regulation strategies before challenges escalate.
Keep everyone working towards the same goals
Enable teachers, special educators, therapists and school leadership to collaborate around shared developmental objectives, reducing fragmented support.
Reduce administrative work
Record observations, upload assessments, document interventions and generate progress reports in one place - giving educators more time to focus on children instead of paperwork.
Extend support beyond the school day
Connect structured school activities into home practice, giving caregivers the guidance they need to continue support beyond the classroom.

h2: Tailored implementation, built around your school’s needs.
p: Every school is at a different stage of its inclusion journey. Some are building their first structured programme, while others are looking to strengthen and scale what already exists.

CognitiveBotics Bloom is a comprehensive implementation programme that combines technology, specialist expertise and ongoing support to help schools build sustainable, high-quality inclusive education programmes. We work alongside your team to ensure every child, educator and family receives the support they need.

Specialists work alongside your team through visits, guidance and mentoring
Personalised support for every learner
Every learner gets developmentally appropriate, goal-aligned support

Continuous monitoring and improvement
Regular reviews and outcome tracking help refine and strengthen practice.

h2: Supporting inclusive education with evidence that matters
p: THE EVIDENCE
Clinically backed
Developed through autism intervention research and evaluated through real-world clinical implementation, with research demonstrating measurable improvements across developmental domains.
Government validated

A study by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Intellectual Disabilities (NIEPID) validates CognitiveBotics as “an effective adjunct to conventional therapy, with measurable improvements in developmental and social domains.”
Patent protected
Built on proprietary AI technology designed specifically for early intervention, personalised learning and developmental support (Indian Patent No. 586929).
Designed around measurable outcomes

A 12-month observational study demonstrated statistically significant improvements across multiple developmental domains when CognitiveBotics was used consistently alongside existing intervention programmes.
